observations.content:
Summary: The first author of the "Attention Is All You Need" paper is Ashish Vaswani. The paper lists eight authors who were all equal contributors: Ashish Vaswani, Noam Shazeer, Niki Parmar, Jakob Uszkoreit, Llion Jones, Aidan N. Gomez, Łukasz Kaiser, and Illia Polosukhin. The order of the authors was randomized according to the paper itself.
